# Zone Pollution

`Zone.js` is a signaling mechanism that Angular uses to detect when an application state might have changed. In some cases, scheduled tasks or microtasks donΓÇÖt make any changes in the data model, which makes running change detection unnecessary. Common examples are `requestAnimationFrame`, `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. You can identify change detection with Angular DevTools, and you can run code outside the Angular zone to avoid unnecessary change detection calls.

resources.title: NgZone in Angular - Improve Performance by Running Code Outside Angular
